meta.subject: fix mcif write ig arb bug for timeout syndrome

en.summary: Fixes MCIF write-ingress arbitration so beat counters, sticky grants, and source ready signals advance only when downstream data is actually accepted.
why_it_counts: The patch corrects a real DUT handshake bug in the write path arbiter.
Without downstream-ready gating, the arbiter can retire beats internally before the splitter consumes them.
That directly matches the timeout-oriented failure mode described in the commit subject.
evidence: The fix introduces src_dat_rdy = arb2spt_dat_ready and threads it into src_cmd*_rdy and src_dat*_rdy generation.
The sticky-clear logic now requires src_dat_vld & src_dat_rdy & is_last_beat, instead of src_dat_vld & is_last_beat alone.
gnt_count also advances only on src_dat_vld & src_dat_rdy, proving the bug was internal beat bookkeeping under backpressure.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A multi-beat write arbiter must hold its grant, beat counter, and source-ready feedback until the downstream stage actually accepts each data beat. If the arbiter advances these internal states on valid alone, downstream backpressure causes the arbiter to think a beat completed when it did not, corrupting grant ownership and eventually stalling or timing out the write path.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any write burst that experiences downstream backpressure while the arbiter is in the middle of a multi-beat grant.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove downstream-ready gating from the beat counter, sticky-grant release, and source ready feedback paths.
portability_notes: The best target is an arbiter that issues one command and then streams multiple data beats for the granted source.
Inject the bug into internal bookkeeping rather than command arbitration itself, so the failure appears only under backpressure.
A realistic mutation should preserve the outward valid signal and only make internal retirement happen too early.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the write arbiter logic that tracks granted source, current beat index, and end-of-burst detection.
Delete the downstream ready term from the conditions that advance the beat counter or clear the sticky grant for the last beat.
Also remove the same ready term from per-source ready feedback so sources believe beats were consumed even when the downstream stage was stalled.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: MCIF write-ingress arbiter beat and grant control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds src_dat_rdy from arb2spt_dat_ready and uses it in source-ready generation, sticky release, and gnt_count updates.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_MCIF_WRITE_IG_arb.v, remove src_dat_rdy from src_cmd*_rdy, src_dat*_rdy, sticky-clear conditions, and gnt_count update logic while keeping arb2spt_dat_valid unchanged.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under data backpressure, the arbiter prematurely retires beats, loses grant/data alignment, and can wedge or timeout the write path.
evidence_for_injection: src_dat_rdy is defined directly from arb2spt_dat_ready, the downstream acceptance signal.
sticky and gnt_count are the exact state variables updated by the patch.
is_last_beat depends on gnt_count, so advancing it early can falsely terminate a burst.
notes: This is a strong reusable injection pattern for any pipelined write arbiter with separate command and data channels.
To reproduce the fault, the validation environment should introduce backpressure on the downstream data interface.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 MCIF 写入口仲裁逻辑，使 beat 计数、sticky grant 和源端 ready 只会在下游数据真正被接收时推进。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复了写路径仲裁器中的真实 DUT 握手缺陷。
如果没有下游 ready 门控，仲裁器会在 splitter 尚未消费数据时就在内部把 beat 提前退休。
这与提交标题里提到的 timeout 症状直接一致。
evidence: 修复新增了 src_dat_rdy = arb2spt_dat_ready，并把它接入 src_cmd*_rdy 和 src_dat*_rdy 的生成。
sticky 清除条件现在要求 src_dat_vld & src_dat_rdy & is_last_beat，而旧逻辑只要求 src_dat_vld & is_last_beat。
gnt_count 也只在 src_dat_vld & src_dat_rdy 时递增，说明问题确实是回压下的内部 beat 记账错误。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 多 beat 写仲裁器必须在下游真正接收每个数据 beat 之后，才推进 grant、beat 计数器和源端 ready 反馈。如果仲裁器只看 valid 就推进这些内部状态，那么一旦下游回压，仲裁器就会误以为某个 beat 已经完成，从而破坏 grant 归属，最终把写路径卡死或拖成超时。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多 beat 仲裁器的接收记账逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任意写 burst 在仲裁器持有多 beat grant 的过程中遇到下游回压。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 从 beat 计数、sticky grant 释放和源端 ready 反馈路径中去掉下游 ready 门控。
portability_notes: 最合适的目标是那种先发一个 command、再为被授予源连续发送多个 data beat 的仲裁器。
应把故障注入到内部记账逻辑，而不是命令仲裁本身，这样只有在回压下才会暴露。
较真实的注入方式是保留对外 valid，只让内部退休动作发生得过早。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到跟踪当前授予源、当前 beat 编号和 burst 结束判定的写仲裁逻辑。
从推进 beat 计数器或在最后一拍释放 sticky grant 的条件里删除下游 ready 项。
同时从各源的 ready 反馈中删除同一个 ready 项，使源端在下游阻塞时也误以为该 beat 已被消费。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: MCIF 写入口仲裁器的 beat/grant 控制逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复从 arb2spt_dat_ready 生成 src_dat_rdy，并将其用于源端 ready、sticky 释放和 gnt_count 更新。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_MCIF_WRITE_IG_arb.v 中，从 src_cmd*_rdy、src_dat*_rdy、sticky 清除条件和 gnt_count 更新逻辑里去掉 src_dat_rdy，同时保持 arb2spt_dat_valid 不变。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在数据回压下，仲裁器会提前退休 beat，破坏 grant/data 对齐，并可能把写路径卡死或拖成超时。
evidence_for_injection: src_dat_rdy 直接来自下游接收信号 arb2spt_dat_ready。
sticky 和 gnt_count 正是补丁修改的状态变量。
is_last_beat 依赖 gnt_count，因此过早推进 gnt_count 会错误地提前终止一个 burst。
notes: 这是一个非常适合复用于其他分离 command/data 通道写仲裁器的故障模式。
验证该故障时，应在下游 data 接口上主动施加 backpressure。
